basic_info.description: Built in 1927, this stately and spacious property combines historic charm with exciting potential. Situated on a detached lot surrounded by tree-lined streets and elegant residences, this home offers a suburban feel while being just minutes from San Francisco's best amenities. Inside, you'll find charming architectural details, including arched doorways, wood-beam ceilings, and refinished hardwood floors. The sunlit living room, anchored by a cozy fireplace. The XL dining room flows into the eat-in kitchenideal for entertaining. The second floor features three spacious bedrooms, each filled with natural light and spacious closets. A flexible lower-level room with an en-suite bath can function as a guest suite, office, or hobby space. A standout feature is the expansive attic, ready to become a family room, game room, or additional living spaceunlocking immense potential. The oversized garage easily fits two cars and includes a laundry area plus workshop. The backyard offers a blank canvas for landscaping, gardening, or outdoor retreats. 329 San Benito Way invites you to restore its vintage charm or modernize it into a showpiece. With endless possibilities to add value and style, this home is a rare find in Balboa Terrace. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!
